nodes.summary: HMM-driven regime detection strategy with per-regime switching and cost controls. Signal float in [-1,1]. Parameters: n_regimes, hmm_lookback, covariance_type, regime_stability_bars, per-regime strategies, max_position, transaction_cost_bps, min_trade_interval_bars.

Maps regimes to strategy configurations. Selects optimal strategy based on current market regime using ensemble regime detection output. Methods: _normalize_regime, select_strategy, adjust_kelly_for_regime.

Multi-variant momentum strategy with cost and frequency controls. Supports ts_momentum, dual_momentum, ma_crossover, macd. Signal float in [-1,1]. Parameters: strategy_type, lookback, fast_lookback, slow_lookback, entry/exit thresholds, transaction_cost_bps, min_trade_interval_bars, signal_smoothing.

Vol arbitrage via vol-ratio z-score. Shorts vol when z > entry_threshold, longs vol when z < -entry_threshold. Parameters: vol_lookback, vol_long_lookback, entry_threshold, exit_threshold, vol_estimation (historical/ewma/garch), transaction_cost_bps, min_trade_interval_bars. Methods include _garch_vol with GARCH(1,1) conditional vol via MLE.
Exponentially Weighted Historical Simulation for VaR and CVaR. Features: configurable half-life for decay factor, rolling window computation, portfolio-level VaR, marginal VaR contribution per asset.

Analyzes portfolio under historical crisis scenarios. Methods: analyze_portfolio, _compute_scenario_impact, _find_worst_period. Computes portfolio impact under specific historical scenarios and finds worst cumulative return periods.

CCXT-based exchange broker supporting 100+ cryptocurrency exchanges. Wraps ccxt.async_support exchange classes and translates between CCXT data structures and Quant Nanggroe Pydantic domain types. Methods: connect, get_ticker, _ccxt_order_to_order, _ccxt_position_to_position.

MetaTrader 5 broker implementing ExchangeInterface. Provides full trading via MetaTrader5 Python API including order placement, position management, market data, account information. Methods: connect, is_connected, state, name, _require_mt5, _get_timeframe_enum.

Extended order lifecycle status with full state machine tracking. Defines trailing stop orders, bracket orders (entry + TP + SL as atomic unit), OCO orders (one-cancels-other), and iceberg orders (hidden quantity display). Includes StateTransitionError and TransitionRecord.

Base exchange module defining ExchangeError hierarchy, ExchangeInterface protocol, exchange configuration models, and standard order/position types. Base exception for all exchange-related errors with subclasses for connection failures and order failures.

Paper trading exchange broker with realistic simulation. Simulates full exchange with order execution, market data generation, position tracking, and portfolio management. Parameters: initial_capital, commission_rate, slippage_bps, min_commission, default_price. Methods: set_price, get_price, add_ohlcv, _update_position, _apply_slippage, check_pending_orders.

Multi-exchange manager with failover and portfolio aggregation. Parameters: health_check_interval, max_errors. Methods: register, unregister, registered_exchanges, primary_name, get_trading_exchange, get_data_exchange, promote_failover, get_status.
Solana wallet service for SPL token account management, keypair management, and balance queries. Includes SPL token account info (address, mint, owner, amount, decimals, ui_amount).

BlackHornet CLI for system status monitoring and agent management. Functions: load_agent_registry, check_bh_system_status, list_agents, check_agent_status, check_mesh_network_status, check_radar_peers, comprehensive_system_health_check.

Load testing framework for API endpoints. Uses multi-threaded worker model to send requests and aggregate results. Methods: _send_request, _get_post_body, _worker, run, _generate_report, _print_report.
Quant Nanggroe AI CLI interface for system operations and management.

Trading signal type definitions. Defines SignalDirection enum, SignalConfidence classification, and TradingSignal model carrying direction, confidence, target price levels, and supporting evidence. Method: compute_strength.
